breadcrumb: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual › Section 1 Executive Summary & Objective
doc_title: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual
header: [FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual | FB-POL-PL-2026-V4 | Section 1 Executive Summary & Objective | p.1]
text:
FinBase Technologies Private Limited ('FinBase') operates a regulated digital lending platform in partnership with licensed Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) and Scheduled Commercial Banks.
The objective of this Personal Loans Master Policy is to provide transparent, standardized, and legally binding guidelines regarding underwriting criteria, loan tenure, interest pricing mechanisms, loan servicing, default penalties, and loan closure workflows.
This document serves as the single source of truth for both customer-facing interactions and internal underwriting operations.

breadcrumb: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual › Section 2 Borrower Eligibility Criteria › 2.1 Age and Nationality
doc_title: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual
header: [FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual | FB-POL-PL-2026-V4 | Section 2.1 Age and Nationality | p.2]
text:
Applicants must be Indian citizens residing within Indian territorial boundaries at the time of application.
• Minimum Age: 21 years completed at the date of loan application submission.
• Maximum Age: 58 years at loan application (or 60 years at the scheduled loan maturity date, whichever is earlier).

breadcrumb: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual › Section 2 Borrower Eligibility Criteria › 2.2 Employment and Monthly Income Thresholds
doc_title: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual
header: [FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual | FB-POL-PL-2026-V4 | Section 2.2 Employment and Monthly Income Thresholds | p.2]
text:
• Salaried Individuals:
• Minimum net monthly in-hand salary of ₹25,000 credited directly via bank transfer (IMPS/NEFT/RTGS). Cash or bearer cheque salary disbursements are strictly inadmissible.
• Minimum continuous employment of 6 months with the current employer, and minimum 12 months total verifiable work experience.
• Self-Employed Professionals & Sole Proprietors:
• Minimum net monthly business income of ₹35,000, verified via the last 2 consecutive financial years of Income Tax Returns (ITR) with Computation of Income and audited balance sheets.
• Business vintage of at least 24 continuous months in the same line of business at the registered operating address.

breadcrumb: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual › Section 2 Borrower Eligibility Criteria › 2.3 Bureau Credit Score and Repayment History
doc_title: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual
header: [FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual | FB-POL-PL-2026-V4 | Section 2.3 Bureau Credit Score and Repayment History | p.2]
section_title: Bureau Credit Score and Repayment History
text:
• Minimum Score Requirement: A bureau score (TransUnion CIBIL or Experian) of not less than 720 is mandatory.
• Delinquency Constraints:
• Zero Days Past Due (DPD) occurrences across all active credit facilities over the trailing 12 months.
• No write-offs, settlements, or restructured loan flags on record within the last 36 months.
• Total existing Fixed Obligation to Income Ratio (FOIR) must not exceed 55% including the proposed FinBase EMI.

breadcrumb: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual › Section 4 Interest Rate Mechanics & Processing Fees › 4.1 Annual Percentage Rate (APR)
doc_title: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual
header: [FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual | FB-POL-PL-2026-V4 | Section 4.1 Annual Percentage Rate (APR) | p.2]
text:
Personal loan interest rates are fixed throughout the contracted tenure, calculated on a monthly reducing balance method.
• Base APR Tier 1 (CIBIL 780+): 10.49% to 11.99% per annum.
• Base APR Tier 2 (CIBIL 750 to 779): 12.00% to 13.99% per annum.
• Base APR Tier 3 (CIBIL 720 to 749): 14.00% to 16.99% per annum.

breadcrumb: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual › Section 4 Interest Rate Mechanics & Processing Fees › 4.2 Upfront Processing Charges
doc_title: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual
header: [FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual | FB-POL-PL-2026-V4 | Section 4.2 Upfront Processing Charges | p.2]
text:
• Standard processing fee is 1.5% of the gross sanctioned loan amount, subject to a minimum of ₹1,000 and a maximum of ₹15,000.
• Goods and Services Tax (GST) at 18% is applicable over and above the processing fee and is deducted upfront from the disbursed proceeds.
• Disbursal stamp duty and e-mandate registration fees (₹150 to ₹400 depending on state of execution) are borne by the borrower.

breadcrumb: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual › Section 5 Repayment, EMI Mandate, and Default Penalties › 5.1 Automated Clearing Mandate
doc_title: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual
header: [FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual | FB-POL-PL-2026-V4 | Section 5.1 Automated Clearing Mandate | p.3]
text:
• All repayments must be executed via automated electronic mandates: NACH, e-NACH, or UPI AutoPay.
• EMIs are debited on the 5th calendar day of each month. If the 5th is a bank holiday, debit is initiated on the preceding working day.

breadcrumb: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual › Section 5 Repayment, EMI Mandate, and Default Penalties › 5.2 Bounce and Overdue Penalties
doc_title: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual
header: [FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual | FB-POL-PL-2026-V4 | Section 5.2 Bounce and Overdue Penalties | p.3]
text:
• Cheque/Mandate Bounce Charge: ₹500 + 18% GST per bounce occurrence.
• Penal Interest: Overdue EMIs attract penal interest at 2.0% per month (24% per annum) calculated on the overdue amount from due date to actual realization date.

breadcrumb: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual › Section 6 Prepayment, Part-Payment, and Foreclosure Guidelines › 6.1 Part-Prepayment Terms
doc_title: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual
header: [FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual | FB-POL-PL-2026-V4 | Section 6.1 Part-Prepayment Terms | p.3]
text:
• Part-prepayment is permitted only after completing a minimum of 6 consecutive monthly EMI cycles from the disbursal date.
• Borrowers may part-prepay up to 25% of the current outstanding principal balance once per financial year without attracting any penalty.
• If part-prepayment exceeds 25% of the outstanding principal in a single financial year, an administrative charge of 1.0% + GST is levied on the amount exceeding the 25% threshold.

breadcrumb: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual › Section 6 Prepayment, Part-Payment, and Foreclosure Guidelines › 6.2 Foreclosure Charges & Rules
doc_title: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual
header: [FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual | FB-POL-PL-2026-V4 | Section 6.2 Foreclosure Charges & Rules | p.3]
text:
• The applicable foreclosure charge is 3% of the outstanding principal if the loan is closed prior to completing 24 months of the repayment tenure.
• If the loan is foreclosed after completing 24 months, the foreclosure charge is reduced to 1.5% of the outstanding principal.
• Full foreclosure is strictly not permitted within the initial 6 months from loan disbursal under any circumstances.
• Foreclosure requests can be initiated directly via the FinBase App under 'Loans -> Service Requests -> Foreclose Loan'.

breadcrumb: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual › Section 6 Prepayment, Part-Payment, and Foreclosure Guidelines › 6.3 No-Objection Certificate (NOC) and Lien Discharge
doc_title: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual
header: [FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual | FB-POL-PL-2026-V4 | Section 6.3 No-Objection Certificate (NOC) and Lien Discharge | p.3]
text:
• Upon settlement of all principal, accrued interest, and foreclosure fees, an authenticated digital No-Objection Certificate (NOC) is generated within 3 business days.
• FinBase updates credit reporting bureaus (CIBIL, Experian, Equifax, CRIF High Mark) within 15 calendar days from the date of final loan closure.

text:

The underwriting engine evaluates bank statement telemetry using 90-day cash flow patterns, recurring salary tags, and payroll direct deposits.

• Clause 7.2: Mandatory debt consolidation disclosures and salary proof verifications.
• Clause 7.3: Address verification protocols via geolocation and Digilocker electricity bill confirmation.
• Clause 7.4: Maximum permissible debt ratio calculations and exceptions.
• Clause 7.5: Customer notification workflows via SMS, email, and authenticated in-app push messages.
• Clause 7.6: Secondary documentation review guidelines for high-value exposures exceeding ₹10,00,000.
• Clause 7.7: Employer categorization matrix and list of non-serviceable pin codes.

section_title: Dispute Arbitration and Customer Grievance Redressal
text:
FinBase enforces a strict 3-tier customer grievance escalation mechanism:
• Level 1 (Support Executive): In-app chat ticket or email to support@finbase.com. Resolution TAT: 48 hours.
• Level 2 (Grievance Officer): If unsatisfied with Level 1, escalate to grievance.loans@finbase.com. Resolution TAT: 5 working days.
• Level 3 (Principal Nodal Officer & RBI Ombudsman): Unresolved disputes beyond 30 days can be appealed directly to the RBI CMS portal (cms.rbi.org.in).

question: What is the foreclosure charge if I close my personal loan in 18 months?
text:
Q001: What is the foreclosure charge if I close my personal loan in 18 months? (Operational case 1)
According to FinBase Personal Loan Policy Section 4.2, because the loan is closed prior to completing 24 months, the applicable foreclosure charge is 3% of the outstanding principal balance plus 18% GST. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-001].
• Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-02.
• Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0001.
• Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 2 Underwriting Manager.
• Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

Q003: Can I close my personal loan within 3 months of getting it? (Operational case 3)

• Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0003.
• Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 1 Underwriting Manager.
• Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

Q004: How much part-prepayment can I make without paying any fee? (Operational case 4)
Under Section 4.1, you can part-prepay up to 25% of the outstanding principal balance once per financial year with zero penalty, provided you have paid at least 6 consecutive EMIs. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-004].
• Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-01.
• Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0004.
• Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 2 Underwriting Manager.
• Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

section_title: Credit Card Processing Rules & Security Standards
text:
FinBase Credit Card Operations Standard FB-CCO-004 outlines tokenization, fraud scoring, and chargeback protocols.
Every transaction is analyzed in real-time by the neural risk engine for geographic anomalies, velocity bursts, and merchant category risks.
• Rule 4.1: Contactless tap-to-pay transaction limits without PIN capped at ₹5,000 per transaction.
• Rule 4.2: Mandatory dynamic CVV generation for online merchant tokenization.
• Rule 4.3: Dynamic currency conversion (DCC) warnings and merchant markup transparency.
• Rule 4.4: Fraud alert telemetry and automatic risk step-up authentication.
• Rule 4.5: Merchant dispute filing workflows under Visa and RuPay chargeback rules.
• Rule 4.6: Virtual add-on card issuance limits for family members.
• Rule 4.7: EMI conversion interest rates starting from 14% p.a. for transactions above ₹2,500.

Daily Balance Slab: Up to ₹1,00,000 | Annual Interest Rate (p.a.): 3.50% p.a. | Calculation Basis: Daily ledger closing balance
Daily Balance Slab: Above ₹1,00,000 and up to ₹10,00,000 | Annual Interest Rate (p.a.): 6.00% p.a. | Calculation Basis: Incremental balance above ₹1L
Daily Balance Slab: Above ₹10,00,000 | Annual Interest Rate (p.a.): 7.00% p.a. | Calculation Basis: Incremental balance above ₹10L
Interest is compounded on a quarterly basis and deposited directly into the savings account.

• Rule 4.5: Branchless doorstep banking requests for senior citizens and differently-abled customers.
• Rule 4.6: Joint account holder mandate requirements and survivorship clauses.
• Rule 4.7: Periodic e-statement generation and cryptographic hash validation.

section_title: UPI Limits and 24-Hour Security Cooling Period
text:
• Standard Daily UPI Limit: Up to ₹1,00,000 per calendar day across peer-to-peer (P2P) transfers.
• Transaction Frequency Limit: Maximum 20 outbound UPI payments per rolling 24-hour window.
• First 24-Hour Cooling Period Security Restriction:
• Whenever a customer links a new bank account or resets their UPI PIN, NPCI security protocols enforce a strict cooling period.
• Outward UPI payments are restricted to a maximum cumulative limit of ₹5,000 for the initial 24 hours following the PIN reset.
• Full ₹1,00,000 daily limit automatically unlocks exactly 24 hours after PIN registration.

doc_title: FinBase Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP
header: [FinBase Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP | FB-SOP-PAY-2026-V4 | Section 2 Failed Transactions and Auto-Reversal Turnaround Time (TAT) | p.2]
section_title: Failed Transactions and Auto-Reversal Turnaround Time (TAT)
text:
When money is debited from a customer's account but the transaction fails or the beneficiary does not receive the credit:
• Mandatory Auto-Reversal TAT: Under RBI and NPCI Harmonization of TAT guidelines, failed transactions must be automatically reversed and credited back to the customer's account within T+2 business days (where T is the transaction date).
• Delayed Reversal Compensation:
• If the reversal takes longer than T+2 business days, FinBase compensates the customer ₹100 per calendar day of delay.
• Compensation is calculated from the expiry of the T+2 window until the exact credit date, deposited directly into the customer's account without requiring any manual claim submission.

text:
• TDS Threshold: TDS is deducted at 10% if the total annual interest income across all deposits exceeds ₹40,000 in a financial year (₹50,000 for senior citizens).

• Zero TDS Exemption (Form 15G/15H):
• Depositors whose estimated total annual income is below the taxable threshold may submit Form 15G (for individuals below 60 years) or Form 15H (for senior citizens aged 60+) digitally via the FinBase App to avoid TDS deduction.

section_title: Explicit Product Exclusions & Unsupported Services Policy
text:
To prevent customer confusion and combat financial scams, FinBase explicitly defines services that are strictly NOT offered or supported on its platform:
• Cryptocurrency & Virtual Digital Assets: FinBase does NOT provide cryptocurrency trading, Bitcoin/Ethereum wallets, or virtual digital asset exchange facilities.
• Agricultural Property Loans: FinBase does NOT offer loans against agricultural farmland or rural mortgage loans.
• Speculative Intraday Tips: FinBase does NOT provide daily stock market intraday calls, F&O options tips, or speculative trading advice.
• Unregulated Chit Funds / Ponzi Schemes: Strictly prohibited under compliance governance.
Customer support assistants must clearly state that these services are unsupported and unavailable in the FinBase knowledge base.

text:
FinBase enforces RBI Customer Protection Guidelines regarding unauthorized electronic banking transactions:
• Zero Liability (100% Refund):
• Applies when unauthorized fraud occurs due to contributory negligence, fraud, or deficiency on the part of FinBase.
• Applies in third-party breaches where the customer notifies FinBase within 3 calendar days of receiving the transaction alert.
• Limited Liability:
• If reported between 4 to 7 calendar days, customer liability is capped at ₹5,000 (or transaction value, whichever is lower).
• Beyond 7 Days:
• Customer liability is determined based on bank board-approved dispute review and case investigation.
